svg.title: Places in the first East India Company voyage, 1601 to 1603
svg.desc: Locator map of maritime Southeast Asia. Aceh sits at the northern tip of Sumatra and Priaman on its west coast. Malacca lies on the Malay peninsula across the straits. Bantam lies at the western end of Java. Far to the east lie the Banda Islands, shown enlarged in an inset: Pulo Run and Pulo Ai to the west, Neira and Lonthor to the east. Run and Ai are only a few miles across.
